[[Fondalz's Artifact]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[focus item]] dropped by [[Fondalz the Spiteful]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Poisoned Outcrops]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +12 (Requires 9 [[Curses]])
:[[Curses]] +1 (20% chance while using [[skills]])
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Skull Brush]] [[dye]]d black.

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, an exact technical replica for this item is the [[Bone Idol]] from collectors [[Denos Makaluum]], [[Yu Lae]], or [[Luci]] or crafter [[Sheco]].


Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this with:
*One of the following [[Curses]] [[focus item]]s:
**[[Bone Idol]] from collector [[Ivarr Stewbrewer]]
**[[Destroyer Focus]] from crafter [[Balthor Coalforge]]
**[[Imperial Focus]] from [[collector]] [[Shen Xi]]
**[[Tormented Focus]] from collector [[Deacon of Whispers]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Master of My Domain]]" inscription
OR
*One of the following [[Curses]] [[focus item]]s:
**[[Bone Idol]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
**[[Asuran Focus]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Focus]] from collector [[Zaishen Necromantic Weapon Master]]
